summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes plus a non-node input test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (39 passed) under the shared venv. black, isort, and mypy are not installed in that venv, so formatting and type-ignore placement were checked by hand only (lines are within 88 columns). Nothing is committed; only the two new files are in the working tree. A cyclic rdf:rest test was not added.
